beliefs: f collapses every run of adjacent identical characters to a single character [E1, E2, E3]
f appends 'h' unless the collapsed result ends with 'h' or ends with a space [E1, E2, E3]
f('h h') gives 'h ' — the space run collapses and the result ends in space so no 'h' is appended [E4]
f('hello hello') gives 'helo ' with trailing space, no 'h' appended [E2]
